questions.prompt: What jobs do map and filter each do, and what do they promise about the array you get back?

keyPoints.text: The three methods are the functional core of working with arrays.
keyPoints.quote: Understand they are the functional core of array work.

keyPoints.text: map's output always has the same length as its input.
keyPoints.quote: map always returns same length array of transformed items.

keyPoints.text: filter keeps only the items whose callback returns a truthy value.
keyPoints.quote: filter keeps only items where callback returns truthy.

keyPoints.text: They produce new arrays instead of changing the original.
Example: turning every title to upper case with map.

questions.prompt: Explain how reduce builds its result, why the initial value matters, and when reduce is the wrong tool.

keyPoints.text: reduce starts from an initial value and accumulates the result from there.
keyPoints.quote: reduce starts with initial value (very important) and builds result.

keyPoints.text: Leaving the initial value out makes the first element the starting accumulator, which causes bugs.
keyPoints.quote: Forgetting initial value in reduce (gets first element as initial — bugs).

keyPoints.text: A sum of watched minutes passes 0 as the initial value.
Counting into an object needs a default for a key seen for the first time.
The object accumulator itself starts as an empty object.
Reaching for reduce on simple sums can be overkill.
keyPoints.quote: Overusing reduce for simple sums when reduce is overkill.

questions.prompt: How does chaining these methods turn raw data into what the UI needs, and what mistake breaks the model?

keyPoints.text: Real use: shaping raw API data into display objects.
keyPoints.quote: Turn raw API movie data into display objects

keyPoints.text: Chaining filter then map picks unwatched high-rated movies and keeps only their titles.
Filtering first and then reducing totals only the watched minutes.
Aggregations like totals per month are a natural reduce use.
keyPoints.quote: compute total minutes watched this month

keyPoints.text: Pushing into outside arrays from inside map or filter defeats their purpose.
